_comment: Paths a deploy rehearsal's tree check leaves out (#3891, design section 13). Every other file in the working tree, ignored ones included, is compared before and after the run. An entry may never be at or under contracts/deployments, a broadcast folder, a forge cache folder or contracts/out; rehearsal-tree.test.mjs refuses one.

leftOut.name: node_modules
leftOut.reason: Installed dependencies, not deploy state; the rehearsal's off-chain runners may install into them, and hashing them would cost minutes per run.
The local knowledge graph, rebuilt by an editor session at any time; never read or written by a deploy.
The storage-layout guard's own compile output, which its build step rewrites by design; the guard checks it against the sources itself.
